add.title: The file indexer run inside a worktree writes "gone" lines for gitignored files that exist in the main tree
add.why: chat-model step 3 (2026-11-02): ai/sessions/files.jsonl gained 11 gone lines (transcripts/, week.json, index.jsonl…) only because the worktree lacks those gitignored files; merged, they would mark live files deleted. Fix: skip gitignored paths when indexing, or never write gone for them.
